written.headline: UN and Barbados call for global AI safety framework within a year
written.summary: At the Bridgetown Special Summit on AI Safety in Barbados, UN Secretary-General António Guterres called on Member States to negotiate a multilateral AI risk management framework within one year. The Bridgetown Call to Action also urged governments and private donors to fund AI capacity-building in the Global South.

written.headline: BP to transfer 3,000 finance staff to Wipro in AI transformation deal
written.summary: BP has entered a strategic partnership with Wipro to transform its finance operations, transferring approximately 3,000 employees across India, Hungary, and Malaysia to the IT services firm. Wipro will deploy its AI and automation capabilities to manage the operations, with the new model expected to take effect in 2027.

written.headline: Infosys reaches CMMI AI Maturity Level 5, first organization worldwide
written.summary: Infosys announced it has become the first company globally to attain Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI) AI Maturity (AIM) Level 5, the highest rating for AI process maturity.

written.headline: Cisco chief warns AI lets attackers find tech weaknesses faster than companies can patch
written.summary: Cisco Chairman and CEO Chuck Robbins said AI is being used to locate technology weaknesses faster than many companies can fix them. He urged business leaders to act immediately, referencing the Alliance for Critical Infrastructure’s 30‑day readiness checklist.
